headline: Whisperwake Isles
title: Whisperwake Isles | Four new regions | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Aniimo's Season One Part Two update adds a brand new map, the Whisperwake Isles. It has four regions: Crescent Bay, Rosy Mirelands, Wildwater Gorge and Cloudreach Falls. The update also brings fifty one new Aniimo to the Idyll Continent. Finish the prerequisite story quests and the island content unlocks on its own. Which region will you explore first? Comment below!
description: Aniimo Season 1 Part 2 adds the Whisperwake Isles map with Crescent Bay, Rosy Mirelands, Wildwater Gorge and Cloudreach Falls, plus 51 new Aniimo.
